purpose.microphone: Autoradio listens when you turn Voice on, so you can ask about a story or tell the radio what to do, and when you record a take. Speech is turned into text on this phone and the audio is not uploaded, except a take you choose to publish.
purpose.recordingInBackground: Voice stops listening when the screen locks; the radio keeps playing.
purpose.speech: Autoradio turns what you say into text on this phone so it can understand your request.
onboarding.askSignIn.title: Sign in to ask the radio
onboarding.askSignIn.why: Listening needs no account; asking does, so the radio has a computer of yours to keep your questions on.
